author: LadyLeigh
name: Pokemon
short: Opt-in Pokémon encounters, collections, trading, and friendly battles.
description: Global Pokémon collections, progression, Pokédex, inventory, parties, trading, and friendly battles, with opt-in per-server channels and luck roles. Spawn interval and global asset administration are bot-owner only. Cached PokéAPI data, Red bank shop, Pokéstop rewards, and two-minute encounters. Raids and full special move effects remain unfinished.
install_msg: Use [p]pokeset to choose a spawn channel and explicitly enable this server. Trainer data merges globally on first load; do not reset existing data. The bot owner controls the global Interval and asset tools. Use [p]pokemon for the player menu. See pokemon/README.md for migration and battle details.
end_user_data_statement: Stores global trainer IDs, Pokémon, parties, inventory, Pokédex catch records, XP, Candy, Stardust, trade proposals, Pokéstop cooldowns, and order journals with originating guild IDs. Per-server enablement, channels, role settings, and encounter records remain separate. Legacy server collections are retained as migration backups. Supports deletion of global and legacy user data through Red deletion requests. Public Discord messages remain in Discord.
